mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence join batch.trigger_request request on request.tenant_id = occurrence.tenant_id and request.workflow_definition_id = occurrence.workflow_definition_id and request.request_id = occurrence.request_id and request.biz_date = occurrence.biz_date join batch.tenant tenant on tenant.tenant_id = request.tenant_id where occurrence.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and occurrence.workflow_definition_id = #{workflowDefinitionId} and occurrence.scheduled_fire_time = #{scheduledFireTime} and occurrence.misfire_detected_at is not null and occurrence.occurrence_status = 'REQUESTED' and request.request_id = #{requestId} and request.trigger_type = 'CATCH_UP' and request.launch_payload ->> 'triggerType' = 'CATCH_UP' and request.launch_payload -> 'params' ->> 'workflowVersion' = occurrence.schedule_version::text and tenant.status != 'SUSPENDED' and ( request.launch_payload -> 'params' ->> 'catchUpPolicy' = 'AUTO' or ( request.launch_payload -> 'params' ->> 'catchUpPolicy' = 'MANUAL_APPROVAL' and exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_misfire_pending pending where pending.tenant_id = request.tenant_id and pending.workflow_definition_id = request.workflow_definition_id and pending.scheduled_fire_time = occurrence.scheduled_fire_time and pending.catch_up_request_id = request.id and pending.status = 'APPROVED' ) ) ) )

select tr.id as tr_id, tr.tenant_id as tr_tenant_id, tr.request_id as tr_request_id, tr.trigger_type as tr_trigger_type, tr.job_code as tr_job_code, tr.workflow_definition_id as tr_workflow_definition_id, tr.biz_date as tr_biz_date, tr.dedup_key as tr_dedup_key, tr.request_status as tr_request_status, tr.related_job_instance_id as tr_related_job_instance_id, tr.parent_workflow_run_id as tr_parent_workflow_run_id, tr.parent_node_code as tr_parent_node_code, tr.trace_id as tr_trace_id, tr.created_at as tr_created_at, tr.updated_at as tr_updated_at, tr.dry_run as tr_dry_run, tr.external_event_code as tr_external_event_code, ji.id as ji_id, ji.trigger_request_id as ji_trigger_request_id, ji.instance_no as ji_instance_no, ji.trace_id as ji_trace_id from batch.trigger_request tr left join lateral ( select candidate.id, candidate.trigger_request_id, candidate.instance_no, candidate.trace_id from batch.job_instance candidate where candidate.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and candidate.dedup_key = tr.dedup_key order by candidate.run_attempt desc limit 1 ) ji on true where tr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tr.request_id = #{requestId}

insert into batch.trigger_request ( tenant_id, request_id, trigger_type, job_code, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dedup_key, request_status, trace_id, dry_run, parent_workflow_run_id, parent_node_code, external_event_code, launch_payload ) select #{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{triggerType}, #{jobCode}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{bizDate}, #{dedupKey}, #{requestStatus}, #{traceId},
#{dryRun} false , #{parentWorkflowRunId}, #{parentNodeCode}, #{externalEventCode}, cast(#{launchPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb) where (cast(#{workflowDefinitionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as bigint) is null or exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_definition workflow_definition where workflow_definition.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_definition.id = #{workflowDefinitionId} )) and (cast(#{parentWorkflowRunId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as bigint) is null or exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_run workflow_run where workflow_run.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_run.id = #{parentWorkflowRunId} ))

insert into batch.trigger_request ( tenant_id, request_id, trigger_type, job_code, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dedup_key, request_status, trace_id, dry_run, launch_payload ) select #{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{triggerType}, #{jobCode}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{bizDate}, #{dedupKey}, #{requestStatus}, #{traceId}, false, cast(#{launchPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb) where (cast(#{workflowDefinitionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as bigint) is null or exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_definition workflow_definition where workflow_definition.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_definition.id = #{workflowDefinitionId} )) on conflict (tenant_id, dedup_key) where trigger_type = 'CATCH_UP' and parent_workflow_run_id is null and left(dedup_key, length(tenant_id) + length(':batch-day-catchup:')) = tenant_id || ':batch-day-catchup:' do nothing
mapper.select: select tr.tenant_id as tenant_id, tr.request_id as request_id, ji.id as job_instance_id from batch.trigger_request tr join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and ji.trigger_request_id = tr.id where tr.request_status = #{requestStatus} and tr.related_job_instance_id is null and tr.created_at < #{olderThan} -- audit fix(HIGH-1 静默丢作业):只回写"真正派发过"的实例。launch 的 T1(建 instance=CREATED)与 -- T2(派发 partition/outbox + 推进状态)分属两段独立事务;若 T2 崩溃,instance 滞留 CREATED 且零 -- partition。原查询不过滤状态,会把这种滞留实例也 JOIN 进来、经 reconcileLaunched 谎报成 LAUNCHED, -- 掩盖"作业从未真跑"。排除 CREATED 后,滞留实例保留为陈旧 ACCEPTED → 进入 ADR-010 既定的"过期 -- ACCEPTED 告警 + 人工/恢复"路径,而非被静默闭环。 and ji.instance_status <> #{excludedInstanceStatus} order by tr.id asc limit #{limit}

with stale_accepted as ( select tr.created_at from batch.trigger_request tr where tr.request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING') and tr.parent_workflow_run_id is null and tr.created_at < #{staleOlderThan} and not exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_run wr where wr.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and wr.trigger_request_id = tr.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_misfire_pending pending where pending.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and pending.catch_up_request_id = tr.id and pending.status = 'PENDING' ) ), recent_launched as ( select extract(epoch from (wr.created_at - tr.created_at)) as latency_seconds from batch.workflow_run wr join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.tenant_id = wr.tenant_id and tr.id = wr.trigger_request_id where tr.parent_workflow_run_id is null and wr.created_at >= #{completedSince} and wr.created_at >= tr.created_at ) select (select count(*) from stale_accepted) as stale_accepted_count, coalesce((select max(extract(epoch from (current_timestamp - created_at))) from stale_accepted), 0)::bigint as oldest_stale_accepted_age_seconds, (select count(*) from recent_launched) as recent_launched_count, coalesce((select percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by latency_seconds) from recent_launched), 0)::double precision as request_to_instance_p95_seconds
